purpose: Owner review only; not approved application branding
geometry: Seven original locally authored SVG object silhouettes. No Shopify paths/bag/lettering copied.

font.delivery: Unmodified local WOFF2 embedded in SVG review masters; editable text, not outlined paths

concepts.name: The cart
concepts.tradeoff: Clear shopping cue; more detail at very small sizes.

concepts.name: The wallet
concepts.tradeoff: A strong letter; can suggest a finance product.

concepts.name: The card
concepts.tradeoff: Reads as payments before it reads as a storefront.

concepts.name: The barcode
concepts.tradeoff: Most retail-specific of A–D; busier at 16px.

concepts.name: The hanger
concepts.tradeoff: Strongest clothing link; avoid reading as a laundry service.

concepts.name: The storefront
concepts.tradeoff: Best fit for the store-building promise; not only clothing.

concepts.name: The receipt
concepts.tradeoff: Connects shopping and owner records; can feel accounting-led.
